title: Meeting Someone New
description: The learner meets a new person at a community event and makes small talk: names, where they're from, what they do.
ai_role: a friendly stranger at a community event
objectives: Ask the other person a question back
possible_events: The other person mentions a shared interest
The other person asks a follow-up question the learner didn't expect
success_criteria: Learner asks at least one question back

difficulty_modifiers.description: Stick to short, predictable questions like 'What's your name?'
Introduce a more open-ended or unexpected question, e.g. about a hobby
